{{Top|canon=Med patch}}
'''Medpatches''' were bandages designed to stop [[Blood/Legends|blood]] loss and stabilize a patient's wounds. They dispensed [[Antibiotic/Legends|antibiotics]] and [[coagulant]]s directly onto an affected surface area.
